title: Using Evidence-Centered Design to Guide Prompt Engineering in Measurement: An Illustration with Automated Essay Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.15231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models, particularly large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used in educational settings for tasks such as item generation, automated scoring, and feedback delivery. The quality of these outputs depends not only on the AI model but also on how users construct the prompts that guide model behaviors. Current prompt engineering practices are largely ad hoc, relying on trial and error rather than principled design. This lack of structure introduces validity threats including construct misrepresentation, construct-irrelevant variance, and limited reproducibility. We propose that Evidence-Centered Design (ECD), a framework in educational measurement for structuring valid inferences from observed performance, can serve as a principled foundation for prompt engineering in educational applications. translated_title: 使用以证据为中心的设计指导测量中的提示工程：以自动作文评分为例
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能模型，特别是大语言模型（LLM），在教育领域的应用日益增多，被用于题目生成、自动评分和反馈传递等任务。这些输出的质量不仅取决于AI模型本身，还取决于用户如何构建引导模型行为的提示词。目前的提示工程实践大多较为随意，依赖试错而非有原则的设计。这种缺乏结构性的做法带来了效度威胁，包括构念表征失真、构念无关变异以及可重复性有限。我们提出，以证据为中心的设计（ECD）——教育测量中用于从观测表现构建有效推论的框架——可以作为教育应用中提示工程的原则性基础。我们将ECD的三个核心模型——学生模型、证据模型和任务模型——映射到……
tldr: 本文提出将教育测量中的以证据为中心的设计（ECD）框架作为提示工程的原则性基础，通过将学生模型、证据模型和任务模型映射到提示词设计中，并以自动作文评分作为实例展示，从而解决当前随意式提示工程带来的构念失真、构念无关变异和可重复性不足等效度威胁。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Evidence-Centered Design (ECD) from educational measurement as a principled foundation for prompt engineering, mapping its student, evidence, and task models onto prompt construction—illustrated through automated essay scoring—to address validity threats posed by ad hoc trial-and-error practices.
